title: Building Telecom Language Models with RSOD: Domain Data, Specialist Post-Training, Memory-Conscious Distillation, and Networking Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2610.27993v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Telecom language models must combine broad networking knowledge with specialist behavior across routing, broadband services, access technologies, and operational diagnostics while remaining practical to deploy as a single model. We present an end-to-end framework that builds source-grounded synthetic training data from structured networking taxonomies and expert graphs, materializes 212,559 routed training records across fourteen networking routes, trains six frozen specialist LoRA teachers over one shared continued-pretrained backbone, and consolidates their behavior into one deployable student adapter using Routed Specialist On-Policy Distillation (RSOD). In RSOD, the committed student generates each trajectory, the route-assigned specialist teacher-forces the exact native token sequence, compact teacher hidden states are reconstructed through the shared frozen output head, and only the student LoRA is updated. translated_title: 使用RSOD构建电信语言模型：领域数据、专家后训练、内存感知蒸馏与网络评估
translated_abstract: 电信语言模型必须将广泛的网络知识与路由、宽带服务、接入技术和运维诊断方面的专家行为相结合，同时保持作为单一模型部署的实用性。我们提出了一个端到端框架，该框架从结构化网络分类体系和专家图谱构建有来源依据的合成训练数据，生成跨越十四条网络路由的212,559条路由化训练记录，在一个共享的持续预训练骨干模型上训练六个冻结的专家LoRA教师模型，并使用路由专家在线策略蒸馏（Routed Specialist On-Policy Distillation, RSOD）将其行为整合到一个可部署的学生适配器中。在RSOD中，已确定的学生模型生成每条轨迹，按路由分配的专家教师对精确的原生token序列进行教师强制，紧凑的教师隐藏状态通过共享的冻结输出头进行重建，且仅更新学生LoRA。一项受控的重建……
tldr: 该论文提出RSOD端到端框架，通过领域合成数据构建、多个专家LoRA教师后训练以及内存感知的在线策略蒸馏，将六个网络专家模型的行为整合到一个可部署的单一电信语言模型中。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes RSOD, an end-to-end framework that builds domain-grounded synthetic telecom training data and consolidates six specialist LoRA teacher models into one deployable telecom language model via memory-conscious routed specialist on-policy distillation.
